'''2000 Brisbane Grand Slam Michael Josem Grand Slam Winner''' is the [[Dark]] constructed list [[Michael Josem]] posted on DeckTech after finishing 1st at [[2000 Brisbane Grand Slam]]. His post (14 March 2000) says "This is the deck I used to win the Canberra Grand Slam". Decipher's Grand Slam 2000 list records his win at the [[2000 Brisbane Grand Slam]] in March 2000,<ref name="gs00">[http://www.decipher.com/tournaments/grandslam2000/index.html Grand Slam 2000], Decipher. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20010716001210/http://bbs.decipher.com/tournaments/grandslam2000/index.html Internet Archive]</ref><ref name="gs00cal">[http://www.decipher.com/calendars/event/mainevents/grandslam/index.html Grand Slam calendar], Decipher. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20010311080940/http://calder.decipher.com/calendars/event/mainevents/grandslam/index.html Internet Archive]</ref> so the wiki files the deck there; the city in the post may be a slip, or Decipher may have listed an event held in Canberra under Brisbane.<ref name="dt-4336">[http://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/4336 Grand Slam Winner], DeckTech (Michael "Joz" Josem, 14 March 2000). Preservation copies: [https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/4336/ Stephen Skilton]; [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/4336/ GitHub Pages]; [https://web.archive.org/web/20261018193819/https://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/4336/ Wayback Machine].</ref>

== Original post ==

'''Grand Slam Winner'''
* '''Author:''' Michael "Joz" Josem
* '''Published:''' March 14, 2000
* '''Rating:''' 4.0
* '''Description:''' This is the deck I used to win the Canberra Grand Slam

=== Strategy ===

You either Duel or battle any LS characters, and use Visage to kill off anything else - Visage is protected by two Holonet Transmissions and two masterful moves and a further 2 copies of it, so you don't need to worry about losing it in a hurry.

Vader and Mara can easily drain for an extra 1 or 2 per turn, and using First Strike and ABC will kill Operatives.
